_what: The words and limits of the meeting settings beyond when to start (meeting-start-settings.json): who the notes go to, smart pages, a calendar event for a recording made outside any event, the languages spoken, standing instructions for the person's AIs and words the speech model should spell right. They are kept in the same saved preference as the start mode (meeting-start-settings.json preference_key), under meeting_notes, transcription and ai_instructions. parts/record-audio/read-data/meeting-settings.mjs reads them; the Meeting recording screen draws them; src/account-transcription.mjs hears with the languages and words; src/share-destinations.mjs hands the chat instructions to the AI a share is sent to.
